channel.title: Strange line when verifying software: not human readable (32 bytes
channel.description:
Ok so when i verify the signatures i get:
gpg: Signature made Wed 15 Jul 2026 04:37:04 AM EEST gpg: using RSA key 6E979B28A6F37C43BE30AFA1CB8D50BB77BB3C48 gpg: Good signature from “Patrick Schleizer <adrelanos@whonix.org>” \[ultimate\] gpg: aka “Patrick Schleizer <adrelanos@kicksecure.com>” \[ultimate\] gpg: aka “Patrick Schleizer <adrelanos@riseup.net>” \[ultimate\] gpg: Signature notation: salt@notations.sequoia-pgp.org=\[ not human readable (32 bytes: Ey??D???IGR???>???..) \] gpg: Signature notation: file@name=Kicksecure-LXQt-18.2.1.9.Intel_AMD64.iso
My question is about this line: gpg: Signature notation: salt@notations.sequoia-pgp.org=\[ not human readable (32 bytes: Ey??D???IGR???>???..) \]
I have not seen it before is it something to worry about or just ignore. Everything else goes as described in the validation process.
